title: New Zealand's Run Rate for Semifinal Spot in ICC World Test Championship
summary: The International Cricket Council (ICC) has announced the top four teams in the ICC World Test Championship. New Zealand is currently ranked third, ahead of Bangladesh and South Africa. To secure a semifinal spot, South Africa needs to surpass India's run rate with at least 118 runs in their remaining matches.
summary_points: The ICC has released the latest rankings for the ICC World Test Championship.
New Zealand is currently ranked third, while Bangladesh is fourth and South Africa is fifth.
South Africa needs to surpass India's run rate to secure a semifinal spot.
India is currently ranked second in the championship.
The ICC has announced that the top four teams will qualify for the semifinals.
